behavior: A button part knows the element of a component in `as` or of the `element` slot only at the mount, and it needs no prop that says what the element is. Until the mount, the element has the attributes that suit a `<button>` and each other element: `type="button"`, `role="button"`, a tab stop, and the disabled state of both. So in the server HTML, Tab reaches a `<div>` before a lazy hydration, and a `<button>` does not submit its form. At the mount, the part keeps the attributes of its element. Base UI needs `nativeButton` set to `false` for an element that is not a `<button>`.
